filesystem.detail: Read/write/edit implementations are exposed, but unconditional turn-wide dedup makes read after write and identical retries stale; no purity contract.

processes.detail: Bash capture is exposed with timeout/composition blacklist; terminal bridge has actual owner wait cycle and 200ms fake completion boundary.

code_actions.detail: Model can author shell command string, but banned operators prevent ordinary multi-command/pipeline composition; no wired general persistent code action kernel.

persistent_kernel.detail: Persistent piped shell exists for TUI, but terminal_send waits on its own blocked turn owner; not an established usable language kernel.

standing_database.detail: standing_database: not established in re-read CLI/Soul/provider/tool/context/audit paths; other compiled historical proposals do not establish active capability.

workflow_programming.detail: Compiled Hook/old Soul APIs are useful small orchestration interfaces; model cannot redefine its turn programs through these exposed tools.

multi_model.detail: Selectable adapters exist, but compatible tool response is TODO and Anthropic request loses tool protocol/endpoint slash; no working multi-provider coding conversation established.

live_collaboration.detail: Bus has addressed send/presence surface, but wired TUI does not consume peer messages into active/queued turns; separate inbox proposals do not establish one collaboration lifecycle.

concurrent_work.detail: Whole turn serially awaits tools and blocks select servicing bridge/user commands; runtime tasks alone do not establish useful concurrent agent work.

steering_interrupt.detail: Interrupt only posts Interrupted status in select command handler; that handler cannot run while awaited Soul turn is active.

turn_redefinition.detail: Fixed compiled old loop is wired; newer reactor continuation remains a stub, no model-authored hot turn policy.

compaction.detail: An unconfigured compactor replaces old content with counts only, clears checkpoints and slices by message count; no semantic preservation or pairing guarantee.

context_repair.detail: Checkpoints store lengths/counts; revert cannot reconstruct deleted originals, and clear leaves checkpoints permitting inconsistent token count.

original_audit.detail: Hook logger omits provider requests/failures, transforms error output to brief, dedup skips hooks and logger errors are swallowed; not comprehensive originals.

audit_query.detail: Append files exist, but no model-facing original audit query/retrieval tool established in wired registry/hook paths.

hot_change.detail: No active-program generation/activation protocol established in wired CLI/fixed Hook/Soul paths; source editing alone is not hot change.

rebuild_continuity.detail: No outpost/quiescence/build/activation/re-inhabitation path established; historical runtime stubs confer no continuity.

remote_services.detail: remote_services: not established in re-read CLI/Soul/provider/tool/context/audit paths; other compiled historical proposals do not establish active capability.

self_improvement.detail: No dedicated live harness experiment/evaluation/governance loop established; legacy source-edit tools are insufficient.

complaints.detail: complaints: not established in re-read CLI/Soul/provider/tool/context/audit paths; other compiled historical proposals do not establish active capability.

authority.detail: No routine command approval loop shown, but blanket forbidden shell syntax and fixed exposed tools materially limit expert/model programming.

evaluation.detail: Local mock checks ID pairing, while compaction recent-window test never triggers and endpoint test checks only string trimming; earlier passing selected tests do not validate broken boundaries.

time_order.detail: UTC timestamp/UUID utilities exposed, but no-argument timestamp is deduplicated within turn, returning stale time; checkpoint wall timestamps do not establish monotonic/refit ordering.

evidence.claim: CLI registers fixed file/shell/skill/utility tools and Soul limits/intervention; no compactor or injector configured.
TUI registers bridge/bus and awaits whole turn in same select that must service bridge; interrupt only sends status after this await.
Old loop calls provider, appends result, sequentially dispatches tools and continues until no calls or step limit.
All matching name/argument results reuse turn cache before hooks or actual execution, without purity/freshness contract.
Outbound conversion drops tool calls and flattens tool-result identity/error to user text.
Messages endpoint concatenates after stripping slash, yielding v1messages for default base.
Compatible response parser handles text and leaves tool_calls parsing TODO.
Read tool loads text then returns line subset.
Write creates parent directories and writes exact content.
Edit rejects no/ambiguous matches then replaces and writes text.
Bash forbids composition syntax then captures output under await timeout without kill_on_drop handling.
terminal_send sends channel request then awaits oneshot reply.
Model can broadcast/whisper/query presence; delivery-to-turn consumption not wired in these paths.
Compiled Hook trait registers turn/tool callbacks, not model-defined continuation program.
Audit observes hooks; tool errors retain brief, no provider originals; dedup bypasses hooks.
Append logger flushes but returns void after printing IO/serialization errors; not all-outcome completeness.
Checkpoints retain lengths/counts only; revert truncates and top-level text-only estimation omits nested outputs.
Compactor deletes old messages and inserts only message/token count, not semantic summary; CLI path does not install it.
New reactor run_turn is explicitly unimplemented.
Registered timestamp returns current UTC and uuid returns random ID; these fixed no-arg actions meet the turn cache.
Local mock tool test asserts call/result ID pairing, not actual provider second request.

tests.focus: Sequential tool-call/result identity under mock provider.
tests.oracle: Asserts two steps and matching call-1 result, while MockProvider ignores actual outbound request; not provider roundtrip oracle.
Fixture ten msgN messages gives 10 estimated tokens against 50 threshold; compact return ignored, so expected msg7 can pass without transformation.
Inspected test checks trimmed base property rather than actual generated request URL and notes defective concatenation; cannot find endpoint failure.

strengths: Small explicit tool/message/context interfaces and local byte-edit tests provide bounded research examples.
Broken ownership, stale dedup and inert oracle cases are useful discriminating counterexamples.
limits: Historical implementation remains quarantined, not adopted baseline.
A build and green local suites do not establish a usable whole harness, complete audit or native rebuild continuity.
arconaut_questions: Which tool effects may ever be reused, and what explicit purity/freshness policy would justify it?
Actual wired-loop tests must observe cancellation, tool settlement, provider roundtrip bytes and original audit across failure paths.
Should all time observations bypass result reuse, and how does refit preserve time-domain identity?
